problem.explanation_gap: Discovery content can now adapt at hypothesis and reformulation time, but problem framing and divergent idea generation still fall back to scenario-authored prose after the evidence state changes.
problem.importance: Evidence-bound problem and idea semantics are needed for useful research autonomy while deterministic taste policy retains selection, transition, budget, and execution authority.

idea_seeds.hypothesis: A command-specific ideation node can preserve evidence continuity from active hypothesis through problem formation and divergent idea generation.
idea_seeds.proposed_mechanism: Bind one typed problem and three divergent idea seeds to the exact predecessor state, active hypothesis, registered observations, runtime ledger, and cumulative budget.
expected_validation: reject unknown observation and hypothesis identifiers
verify semantic history and cumulative cost
idea_seeds.main_risk: The scripted run proves lineage and authority boundaries but not open-ended scientific creativity.

idea_seeds.hypothesis: A larger library of scenario-authored problems and idea seeds can approximate enough adaptive behavior without an ideation model call.
idea_seeds.proposed_mechanism: Select fixed problem and idea templates using deterministic observation and hypothesis tags.
idea_seeds.main_risk: The caller must anticipate the useful problem framing and mechanisms before observing evidence.

idea_seeds.hypothesis: An unconstrained research agent can generate and select stronger ideas by controlling the entire post-probe workflow.
idea_seeds.proposed_mechanism: Delegate problem framing, idea ranking, state mutation, and execution to one free-form provider response.
idea_seeds.main_risk: Evidence, resource, selection, and transition authority become difficult to audit or reproduce.

alternative_problem_formulations: Frame the remaining gap as semantic continuity across nonlinear Discovery stages.
Frame the remaining gap as divergent idea generation under evidence and resource constraints.
output_payload.uncertainty: This bounded scripted self-iteration validates contracts and project ownership; live-model scientific-quality gains remain unmeasured.
